answer: To blunt sybil floods, each new agent locks a refundable bond that unlocks only after many epochs of peer-reviewed work. Unpredictable live challenges arrive as a pulse: the claimant has seconds to sign a fresh nonce with one long-lived key. A hunting falcon does not chase every shadow in the flock; attestors likewise track one key's timing, style, and stake path. Clones that share a key collide on the nonce, while clones that mint new keys lack history and forfeit the bond, which a public violet mark records as slashed.
